points.description: Justification: a pipe is one-directional; data written to fd[1] (write end) is read from fd[0] (read end), and reading from fd[1] / writing to fd[0] is not the way it works.
points.partial_credit: Justification vague or only half stated (e.g. only says fd[0] is read and fd[1] is write, or just says pipe is unidirectional) earns about half.

rubric.notes: Full marks: answer says TRUE and explains that the pipe is one-way, with fd[1] for writing and fd[0] for reading, in any wording. Part marks: correct TRUE with a vague or incomplete justification. No marks for FALSE, or for TRUE with no justification at all (the question says no justification means no marks).
